text: Visited on a Saturday morning. Pressed the intercom at the side gate on Mill Lane and someone came within a couple of minutes. Ramp is steep but fine in a powered chair. Lift worked. Accessible toilet on the ground floor was clean.
Lift was out of order with a sign on the door. Event was upstairs in the Main Hall so I could not attend. Nobody told us in advance and the website still said lift to all floors.

needs: walks short distances, uses a stick
text: I can walk but not far. From the parking on Mill Lane to the side gate there is nowhere to sit. The ramp has no bench and I had to stop twice. When I got to the foyer all four chairs were taken. Staff found me a chair eventually but I nearly gave up.

I checked before travelling and the website said accessible. Arrived 18:30 for an evening event. The main entrance had stairs. The side gate on Mill Lane was locked and nobody answered the intercom. A guard eventually came and said the lift was out of service and suggested my friends carry me up the stairs. I missed the event and paid for accessible transport twice.
